title: Kamen Rider Gavv
description: Granutes are intelligent lifeforms that operate secretly in the human world. They kidnap people for the sake of “Black Market Sweets.” As people are attacked one after another by the Granutes, Shoma, a young man from another world, rises up to save the people. Together with the Gochizo, small monsters born from eating sweets, he transforms into Kamen Rider Gavv with a mouth-like belt!

episodes_data.title: Kamen Rider Gavv Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Shoma, who comes from a different world, is saved by a boy named Hajime when he collapses from hunger. Shoma excitedly eats the snacks that Hajime gave him, but as soon as he does, Gochizo are born one after another. Meanwhile, freelance writer Hanto is gathering information on the appearance of "monsters" while doing research.

episodes_data.title: Kamen Rider Gavv Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Shoma, who has collapsed from hunger again, is helped by Sachika, who runs an anything-and-everything general store, and treats him to lunch and snacks. Meanwhile, Hanto discovers information about Gavv on social media and starts interviewing witnesses...

episodes_data.title: Kamen Rider Gavv Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: After leaving Sachika's house, Shoma encounters Sujimoto. Upon seeing Shoma's strength he offers him a job. Meanwhile, Hanto asks Sachika to look into sightings of Gavv and the Granutes.

episodes_data.title: Kamen Rider Gavv Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: After accidentally trying to eat a vegetable in their garden out of hunger, Shoma is invited into Ryoji and Mutsuko's house. Hanto goes to Suga's laboratory in order to learn more about the Granutes.

episodes_data.title: Kamen Rider Gavv Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Shoma collapsed from hunger and was saved by a mysterious monster. Is it a new Granute? Shoma wakes up and transforms into Gavv, but his movement was halted by an unexpected reaction: "The surgery was a success!" Who is this monster?

episodes_data.title: Kamen Rider Gavv Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Shoma starts a new life at Sachika's "Happipare". Meanwhile, Suga has succeeded in developing an item that can transform a person into a Kamen Rider, and asks Hanto to try it out.
